title: STAR: Counterfactual Dual-World Rollouts and Spatial Target Adaptive Reconstruction for Visual On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models often rely on global context and language priors while overlooking answer-determining local details. Privileged visual on-policy self-distillation supervises full-image student rollouts using a frozen teacher that views high-resolution evidence crops. Yet our cross-scale diagnostics show that models retain over half of their full-image accuracy when local evidence is completely masked, indicating that single-image correctness does not guarantee reliance on local evidence, while the need for visual correction also varies across tokens with their spatial attention states. We propose STAR, a visual on-policy self-distillation framework combining independent counterfactual dual-world rollouts with spatial-attention-guided target reconstruction. translated_title: STAR：用于视觉在线策略蒸馏的反事实双世界推演与空间目标自适应重建
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型往往依赖全局上下文和语言先验，而忽视决定答案的局部细节。特权视觉在线策略自蒸馏使用一个冻结的教师模型（其可查看高分辨率证据裁剪图）来监督学生的全图推演。然而，我们的跨尺度诊断显示，当局部证据被完全遮蔽时，模型仍能保持其全图准确率的一半以上，这表明单张图像上的正确性并不能保证模型真正依赖局部证据；同时，对视觉校正的需求也随各个token及其空间注意力状态的不同而变化。我们提出STAR，这是一个视觉在线策略自蒸馏框架，结合了独立的反事实双世界推演与空间注意力引导的目标重建。局部图像编辑构建出具有相同问题和背景、但决定答案的关键事实不同的配对世界，其中共享的学生模型独立采样轨迹……
tldr: STAR通过反事实双世界推演与空间注意力引导的目标自适应重建，迫使视觉语言模型在在线策略自蒸馏中真正依赖决定答案的局部视觉证据，而非语言先验和全局上下文。
en_tdlr: STAR combines counterfactual dual-world rollouts with spatial-attention-guided adaptive target reconstruction in a visual on-policy self-distillation framework, forcing vision-language models to genuinely rely on answer-determining local visual evidence rather than language priors and global context.
